# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stands (iPhone + Apple Watch + AirPods)

These picks come mainly from WIRED's testing of 30+ models and Macworld's reviews.

## 🏆 Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand (~$80–$109)
WIRED's top pick. It's a chrome "tree" design that holds the iPhone and Watch in the air, with the AirPods spot on the base.
- **Pros:** The iPhone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy mode. It fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7 and later. A 36W adapter is included, and the warranty is 2 years.
- **Cons:** It charges the iPhone at 15W, not 25W, and the cable is permanently attached.
- **Price:** WIRED lists it at $80 at Best Buy, $90 at Amazon and $98 at Belkin.
- **Where to buy:** Use the shop links in [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/).

## ⚡ Fastest premium: Nomad Stand One Max ($169)
- **Pros:** It charges the iPhone at Qi2 25W and fast-charges the Watch. The glossy, heavy base lets you lift the phone off with one hand, and you get a 6.6-ft braided cable.
- **Cons:** It's expensive, and **no power adapter is included**. You need one rated at 40W or more.
- **Where to buy:** Nomad's shop link in [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/).

## 💰 Best value: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station (~$40, down from $80)
WIRED calls it "by far the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1" they've tested.
- **Pros:** It charges the iPhone at 15W, supports StandBy, and includes a 33W adapter and cable. The Watch puck detaches so you can travel with it.
- **Cons:** The warranty is only 1 year.
- **Where to buy:** Amazon link in [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/).

## 🔥 25W on a budget: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Qi2.2 (25W)
- **Pros:** It charges at 25W and has an active cooling fan that you can switch off at night. A 50W adapter is included.
- **Speed by iPhone:**
  - iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus: 25W
  - iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro: 20W
  - Older iPhones: 15W
- **Deal:** One deal site says code **PARTNER18** brings it from $99.99 to about **$82** at ESR's US store. They say they tested the code on 10/23 and that it expires 12/31.
- **Where to buy:** [Buy via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand). This is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission. You can also search ESR's store directly.
- **Caveat:** WIRED says the 25W version is "far more expensive for very little gain" if you mostly charge overnight.

## 🧳 Taller desk stand that also folds: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Qi2 25W ($129.99)
- **Pros:** Macworld says it's the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1, raising the iPhone more than 70mm. It includes a 45W adapter with US, UK and EU plugs.
- **Where to buy:** See the [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html) for retailer links.

---

**Quick advice:**
- **Mostly overnight charging:** 25W barely matters, so get the **Belkin** or the **$40 ESR**.
- **Fast top-ups on an iPhone 16 or 17:** Get the **Nomad**, or the **ESR CryoBoost** if you want to spend less.
- **Before buying:** Make sure your AirPods case supports wireless charging.

Prices change often, so check the final price at checkout.
